parts.label: Box
parts.note: Fit the board on its standoffs and set the box on the bench, open side up.

parts.label: Lid
parts.note: Turn the lid over and press it on: the lip goes inside the walls.

hardware.name: Lid screw
hardware.source: ISO 7380 / 14583, or a self-tapping screw of that size
hardware.note: Screw the lid down at the four corners into the heat-set inserts.
